swordfish.why: N+N apposition compound: only the head noun pluralizes; second element stays singular. RAE/DPD: 'pez espada' → 'peces espada'.

teddy-bear.why: Singular is diminutive 'osito' but plural dropped the diminutive; s/p must agree → 'ositos de peluche'.

tuna.why: Singular 'atún' is aguda ending in -n (accent required); plural 'atunes' is llana ending in -s (no accent).

turkey.why: Singular is Mexican-register 'guajolote'; plural must match the same lemma → 'guajolotes' (not the peninsular 'pavos').

vase.why: Singular 'florero' but plural switched lemma to 'jarrones'; s/p must agree → 'floreros'.

stairs.why: 'escalera' is feminine (la escalera / las escaleras); WordReference marks (nf).

tights.why: 'media' is feminine (la media / las medias); WordReference marks (nf).

tongs.why: 'pinza' is feminine (la pinza / las pinzas); WordReference marks (nf).

vegetables.why: 'verdura' is feminine (la verdura / las verduras); WordReference marks (nf).
